items.title: Show HN: Leafpress- a static site generator for digital gardens
items.contentSnippet:
leafpress is a modern, minimalistic, opinionated static-site generator for digital gardeners like me. It allows wrapping over any existing folder of MD files and quickly generate website from it. Common markdown and Obsidian-specific syntax/features are supported.

items.contentSnippet: One-shot performance of LLMs is a good measure of many of its capacities, but it is only sufficient for tasks that can be objectively and automatically verified. I believe that in most real-world cases this is not the case: people have vague, unquantifiable, taste-based, complex goals, and it's the way one works closely with AI over many prompts that makes the difference between slop and actual work.
